2115475008113823855.en_summary: Gene Munster is getting more concerned about $AMZN as personalized bots make it easier to find what you want, attacking Amazon's key advantage of discovery while speed and trust remain. Early data and Zuck's comment on Muse's commerce use case support this; global daily bot usage ~20m, expected 2B in three years. Also concerned about $GOOG needing an answer to personalized bots, with cloud growth expectations of 92% Sept / 95% Dec and capex street at $201B CY26 / $312B CY27.
2115475008113823855.zh_summary: Gene Munster 對 $AMZN 愈來愈擔憂，因為個人化機器人讓尋找所需商品變得更容易，衝擊亞馬遜在「找到想要的東西」這項關鍵優勢，而速度與信任仍在。早期數據及 Zuck 關於 Muse 主要用於商業的評論支持此觀點；全球每日機器人使用量約 2000 萬，預期三年內達 20 億。同時對 $GOOG 需要應對個人化機器人也感到擔憂，雲端增長預期 9 月 92%、12 月 95%，資本支出街預期 CY26 為 2010 億美元、CY27 為 3120 億美元。

2115471350114783595.en_summary: $AMZN shows insane demand. Quoted Amazon CEO Andy Jassy on AWS capacity: “26 is obviously at this point sold out, 27 is largely sold out ... a good chunk of 28 is sold out.” Expects shortages of data centers, power and memory to persist beyond 2027.
2115471350114783595.zh_summary: $AMZN 顯示需求極為強勁。引用亞馬遜 CEO Andy Jassy 談 AWS 容量：「26 年目前顯然已售罄，27 年大部分已售罄……28 年也有相當部分已售罄。」預期數據中心、電力與記憶體短缺將持續至 2027 年之後。

ticker_notes.AMZN: AWS 容量 2026-2028 年大部分已售罄，短缺持續
